digest.component_or_area: Gerrit CI workflow routing and documentation validation
propositions: Documentation-only Gerrit changes currently run the full OS/Python matrix, mutation, packaging, and optional jobs; they should route to a reduced docs-only lane that executes documentation gates only, skipping expensive build/test and mutation jobs.

A trusted classifier job must execute from origin/main with credentials disabled, consuming only the exact patchset diff (HEAD^..HEAD) as untrusted data, and emit route=docs-only only if all changed paths match an allowlist and no classifier execution itself fails.

Existing inline documentation gates must be extracted once into a shared composite action (.github/actions/docs-gates/action.yml) and reused by both full and docs-only routes without creating an additional runner job.

Classifier job failure or cancelled state must trigger full-route job execution via always() && (needs.classifier.result != 'success') while still blocking Verified, and missing route output or any non-allowlisted path must fall back to full Verify.

All structural workflow consumers (test_gate_step_tree_skew.py, test_ci_workflow_parity.py, test_dependency_advisory_wiring.py, etc.) must be migrated to follow extracted gates, and vote.needs aggregation must include classifier and docs-only results as required fail-closed conditions.

Production post-merge validation must demonstrate genuine docs-only changes select and complete the focused documentation lane (reducing wall clock and runner-minutes) while genuine non-doc changes select and complete the full test suite.
